description: Search the user's wiki across EVERY project (not just the current one). Returns ranked matches with their owning project id, suitable for citing as `[[<project>/<slug>]]` cross-project wikilinks. Use this when answering open-ended "have I seen this before" questions or proposing cross-project bridges during ingest.

crossProjectOnly.description: If true, exclude results from the current project. Useful when looking only for cross-project bridges.

query.description: Search query (1+ chars). Matches against slug, title, and one-liner.

name: search_all_projects
